concerns.text: The plan calls OpenAI `gpt-3.5-turbo` without pinning a specific model version (e.g., `gpt-3.5-turbo-0613`). This can break Principle I (Reproducibility) because model updates may change outputs even with temperature=0.

The plan does not include an explicit check that the aggregated vulnerability table contains at least 5 distinct OWASP vulnerability types, which is required by Success Criterion SC‑005 in the constitution.
